Author: Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari
Bench: Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari
 1 
 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 Crr No. 3160 of 2021
 (Santosh Kumar Patel Vs The State Of Ma
 Jabalpur, Dated : 07-12-2021
Shri Sunil Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the   Shri Sanjeev Kumar Singh, learned Panel Lawyer fo Heard on the question of admission.
This criminal revision appears to be arguable, hence, it is admitted for final hearing.
Since this revision has been filed within time, I.A. No.21090/2021, which is an application for condonation of delay is closed.
Shri Sanjeev Kumar Singh accepts notice on behalf of the respondent/State.

Record of the Courts below be called for.
Heard on I.A. No.21491/2021, which is an application filed under Section 397 of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.

This criminal revision is directed against the judgment dated 23.03.2021 passed by the 19th Additional Sessions Judge, Jabalpur (M.P.) in Cr.A.No.179/2018, whereby the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 17.05.2018 passed by Judicial Magistrate First Class,
Jabalpur (M.P.) in Criminal (Complaint) Case No.2902836/1993 has been affirmed.

Consequently,
the applicant stands convicted under Section 7(1) R/w Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for one year with fine of Rs.2,000/-, with default stipulation.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that present applicant is in custody since 10.11.2021 and he has wrongly been convicted.
Learned Courts below have erred in appreciating the evidence on record.
In view of outbreak of COVID-19, detention of the applicant in already congested prison may be detrimental.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Jabalpur.
There are fair chances of success of this revision and the revision 2 CRR-3160-2021 may take long time for its conclusion.

sentences.text: With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for suspension of sentence is made.
The prayer is opposed by learned counsel for the State.
Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, I.A. No.21491/2021 is allowed.

I t is, therefore, directed that if applicant namely Santosh Kumar Patel deposits the entire fine amount along with the interest, if not already deposited, and furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 8 th March, 2022 and on such subsequent dates as may be fixed in this regard, the sentences of imprisonment awarded to him shall remain suspended till further orders and he shall be released on bail.

The applicant shall also furnish a written undertaking that he will abide by the terms and conditions of various circulars, as well as, orders issued by the Central Government, State Government and local administration from time to time such as maintaining social distancing, physical distancing,
hygiene etc. to avoid proliferation of Corona virus.
List this case for final hearing in due course.
A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy/e-copy as per rules/directions.
